dct_description_sm:
Brampton Plan Schedule 6B Water Resources System features consist of rivers, streams, wetlands, groundwater features, and other hydrologic elements that support the movement and quality of water throughout the city. This interconnected system is essential for ecosystem health, flood management, groundwater recharge, and sustainable growth.

This data is intended to be used in conjuction with other related mapping layers for this schedule, and may be impacted by other schedules, with consideration to the text of Brampton Plan.
